args.statement:
The remaining acceptance failure is reproduced at its real boundary: the direct-delivery hook is spawned by the agent's Bash tool and inherits the workspace sandbox. A measured hook can write inside /run/stage/world but cannot write /run/stage/state/.sandbox-hook-canary (Permission denied), which is where the project journal lives. The hook therefore could not append the delivery record it had correctly decided to make. A second independent gap is the ref shape: the candidate bundle carries only HEAD, and when the prepared review is exposed as a tag or bare commit rather than a local branch, the branch-tip test refused to name the new review path.

Fix in ebbafa1: (1) the guard starts a bounded in-process observer (250 ms, 10-minute window, restarted by each pulse) when a deployment is live; it watches HEAD in the product process outside the Bash sandbox and calls the same runDirectDeliveryGuard. (2) Prepared advances are recognised from HEAD's reflog (merge/pull), with the branch-tip check retained as a fallback. Both paths only refresh a current existing DELIVER conclusion; they create no judgement, accept nothing, promote nothing and advance no canonical head, and still refuse ordinary commits, dirty trees, moved bytes, resolved/reopened conclusions and reopening journal facts.

Verification: scripts/pnwf/software/self-maintenance-prepared-ref.mjs passes 72/72 over the sealed case-1/case-2 owners and receipt commits for both arms, with branch, tag, bare-commit and hook-removed scenarios plus ordinary-commit controls. On pre-fix 2ba8c7f it exits 1 with 24 false checks (tag/bare and watcher); a reflog-only build fails only the four watcher checks, isolating both causes. All existing maintenance oracles pass; test/pnwf_direct_guard.test.ts 6/6 and alhs_episode_convergence 13/13. Two unrelated deployment tests still fail only because this isolated checkout lacks e2e/project-workspace.spec.ts and examples/deployment. Limit: the observer runs only while the deployment is live; a commit made with no product process still relies on the hook or on the next pulse's required action. Operator acceptance, promotion and the canonical-head decision remain with the operator.

(2) Prepared advances are recognised from HEAD's reflog (merge/pull), with the branch-tip check retained as a fallback.
